title: Terminator
blurb: Every sequel after the second one branches into its own timeline, so a single chronological line is a polite fiction. Here it is anyway.

groups.title: The first two films
groups.note: Every later film follows on from these.

groups.title: Rise of the Machines and Salvation
Genisys
groups.note: Rewrites the first film into a new timeline.

groups.title: Dark Fate
groups.note: Another continuation of Judgment Day, ignoring the three films before it.

note: Dark Fate is a direct sequel to Judgment Day and ignores the three films in between. If you want one clean story, watch The Terminator, Judgment Day and Dark Fate, and treat the rest as alternatives.
